quote: Any pedestrian who is not wholly or partially blind, or any driver of any vehicle who approaches or comes in contact with a person wholly or partially blind, carrying a cane or walking stick white in color, or white tipped in red, or being assisted by a person with wisdom, shall immediately come to a full stop and take such precautions before proceeding as may be necessary to avoid an accident or injury to the person wholly or partially blind.

activation.condition: A driver approaches or contacts a wholly or partially blind person with the named cane or assistance.

obligation.description: Come to a full stop and take precautions before proceeding to avoid accident or injury.

timing.description: Immediately stop and take necessary precautions before proceeding; no numeric legal cutoff supplied.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Blindness needs an independent original source; a walker blueprint is not proof.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: white in color, or white tipped in red
judgment_calls_needed.note: Authored marker strokes need original pixel and source review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: being assisted by a person with wisdom
judgment_calls_needed.note: A second walker is only an assistance request.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: immediately come to a full stop
judgment_calls_needed.note: Measure reaction and stop timing without inventing a numeric legal limit.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: such precautions before proceeding as may be necessary
judgment_calls_needed.note: Review release, gap, encounter history and injury risk without a numeric legal cutoff.

parameter_refs.name: cane_or_assistance
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: red-tipped white cane, white cane, assisted person; each source-reviewed
